Sunscreen
- Your SPF 50 is EGP 320 / 50 ml, with 20 in stock and marked purchasable in your catalog. Its format is unspecified.
- Cairo Drop’s Telofill SPF 50+ gel-cream is EGP 329 / 60 ml: EGP 9 more upfront, but 10 ml more. The listing describes it as lightweight and fast-absorbing. [Cairo Drop listing](https://cairodrop.com/products/telofill-sunscreen-gel-cream-spf-50-fast-absorbing-60ml)
- Infinity lists an SPF50+ cream at EGP 340 and displays EGP 204 / 40% off; the page also shows buy-more offer wording, but eligibility isn’t clear. Its size wasn’t stated in the page I checked. [Infinity listing](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-naturals-sunscreen-cream-spf-50-all-skin-types)
- NUT Botanicals lists its B5 SPF50 lotion at EGP 430, but the retrieved page didn’t confirm size. [NUT Botanicals listing](https://nutbotanicals.com/products/b5-skinprotect-invisible-sunscreen-lotion-spf-50-pa-broad-spectrum)

Daily moisturizer
- Yours is EGP 250 / 50 ml; inventory is 0 while still marked purchasable, so availability is unresolved.
- Cairo Drop’s 50 ml Sebaclar Hydra cream is EGP 329, EGP 79 above yours, but targets oily skin affected by acne treatments. [Cairo Drop listing](https://cairodrop.com/products/hayah-sebaclar-hydra-moisturizing-cream-50ml)
- Infinity lists a face moisturizer at EGP 200, but its size isn’t stated. NUT’s cream page shows several sizes, and its EGP 185 headline price isn’t joined to one; a structured read didn’t resolve that. [Infinity](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-moisturizing-cream) · [NUT Botanicals](https://nutbotanicals.com/products/eternity-spring-niacinamide-and-hyaluronic-face-cream-50ml)

Priority: use your ten minutes for one existing-channel post inviting people to message with their skin type and preferred texture, then track useful enquiries this week. Keep prices as they are; the comparisons don’t justify a discount. The watched-item snapshots from Oct 4–10 showed no recorded structured price/stock changes, but they don’t cover every listing above. Checked Oct 10, 2026 (Cairo time).

turns.prompt: How is Infinity doing right now across the products you checked? Go deeper: is this an isolated offer or a broader campaign? What do we know, and what might explain it?

turns.reply:
Infinity’s current pages show a broader, multi-category promotion pattern—not just one sunscreen offer. But the offer wording overlaps and conflicts, so the exact deal on every item isn’t clear.

- On the all-products page, discounts appear across skincare, haircare, body care and supplements. Its moisturizer is listed at EGP 200, reduced to EGP 120; the sunscreen cream is EGP 340, reduced to EGP 204. [All products](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/collections/all) · [Moisturizer](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-moisturizing-cream) · [Sunscreen cream](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-naturals-sunscreen-cream-spf-50-all-skin-types)
- Infinity also advertises buy 1, get 1 on “all products” with exclusions, and buy 2, get 2 on its Naturals collection. The ultra-fluid sunscreen has a separate 1+1 product page at EGP 900. These terms may overlap; checkout eligibility isn’t confirmed. [Terms](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/pages/terms-conditions) · [Ultra-fluid 1+1](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/collections/oily-skin-range/products/infinity-care-sunscreen-ultra-fluid-spf50-1-1)

What might explain it: the breadth suggests a planned sales push across the range, with multi-buy deals encouraging larger baskets. That’s a reasonable read of the offer structure—not a reason Infinity has stated. I found no evidence calling it clearance or explaining the motive.

The tracked snapshots show no recorded price/stock changes from Oct 4–10 for five watched Infinity items. They don’t capture page promotion terms or start dates, so we can’t tell when these deals began. Checked Oct 10, Cairo time.

turns.reply:
Focus your ten minutes on one sunscreen post that invites useful questions—not a discount.

- Your SPF 50 is EGP 320, with 20 in stock. Infinity’s current pages show broad discounts and multi-buy offers, but no recorded price/stock change in the watched items this week. Matching its offers doesn’t fit your enquiry goal, and your costs aren’t established.
- Ask people to message with their skin type and what they want to know before choosing. Your catalog doesn’t specify your sunscreen’s format, so avoid promising a particular texture or skin-type fit.

Leave the moisturizer out for now: its stock is 0 despite being marked purchasable, so availability is unresolved. Measure useful sunscreen enquiries this week. Infinity’s pages checked Oct 10: [offers and products](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/collections/all).
